annotations.title: Get a link to ask for a watch

description: For a watch that is not listed, or not listed the way the customer wants it, or a watch the customer owns and is thinking of selling. Returns a WhatsApp link to a Watches in Stock specialist with a draft note. It only returns a link: nothing is sent, ordered, reserved or paid for. Use it only when the customer asks for that help; each call asks the store for its next specialist.

app.description: The app the customer is using, such as Claude or ChatGPT, named in the note.

purpose.description: find (the default) to look for a watch to buy; sell when the customer owns the watch and is thinking of selling it.

request.description: The watch, such as "a 2019 Batgirl, full set, under USD 20,000", or for selling "2021 Rolex Batgirl 126710BLNR, full set".

name: get_sourcing_link
title: Get a link to ask for a watch
